mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, both of which are involved in rivaroxaban metabolism and efflux, leading to increased rivaroxaban plasma concentrations and bleeding risk.
action: Monitor closely for signs of bleeding; consider alternative antibiotic with less CYP3A4 inhibition (e.g., azithromycin) or reduce rivaroxaban dose if clarithromycin is necessary.
